archetype: ELECTRIC & NEON meets TACTICAL MINIMALISM (Futuristic AI Portal)
emotional_tone: Cinematic, hyper-intelligent, secure, visionary, fluid quantum technology

fonts.heading: Outfit, Clash Display, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif
fonts.body: IBM Plex Sans, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif
fonts.instructions: Import Google Fonts Outfit:wght@400;500;600;700;800 and IBM Plex Sans:wght@400;500;600 in index.html or index.css. Never use Inter for main headings.

logo_specification.description: User-specified 3D swirling vortex / spiral quantum orb in electric blue, cyan and purple neon on dark/transparent background.
logo_specification.svg_or_interactive_canvas: Include an animated swirling SVG / CSS 3D vortex orb component alongside real curated backdrop images for the brand badge and hero visual.

layout_and_grid.hero_auth_split: On lg screens: 12-column asymmetric split grid. Left 5-6 cols dedicated to the Quantum AI Interactive Brand Showcase (glowing 3D vortex logo, real-time quantum cluster telemetry, encryption badge, quotes/feature teasers), Right 6-7 cols dedicated to the active Glassmorphic Auth Card (Login, Sign-up, or Guest handoff). On mobile: stacked with compact glowing brand header.
layout_and_grid.padding_scale: p-6 sm:p-8 lg:p-10 inside cards to avoid text collision with glowing borders

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam_or_neon_rim: Top accent gradient border: h-[1px] w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-cyan-400 to-purple-500
visual_enhancers.mesh_background: Radial cyan and purple gradient flares at coordinates (top left and bottom right) with subtle star particles canvas or CSS grid scanline overlay
visual_enhancers.password_strength_indicator: 4-segment reactive neon meter (Weak: Rose-500, Fair: Amber-500, Good: Cyan-400, Quantum-grade: Emerald-400 + Purple glow)
visual_enhancers.button_styling: Primary: rounded-xl font-medium tracking-wide bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 via-blue-600 to-purple-600 text-white shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(6,182,212,0.4)] hover:shadow-[0_0_35px_rgba(168,85,247,0.6)] hover:brightness-110 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all duration-200. Secondary: rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-200

QuantumLogo.description: Custom swirling 3D vortex SVG with cyan/purple concentric energetic rings and core orb pulse.

AuthLayout.description: Split screen layout with starfield canvas, glowing mesh backdrop, brand showcase, and responsive glass container.

LoginForm.description: Email or Username field, password with toggle show/hide, remember me checkbox, Google OAuth mock/ready trigger, Guest mode link, login action button.

SignUpForm.description: Display name, email, password with live strength evaluation, confirm password match verification, terms acknowledgment, Google sign-up, submit button.

PasswordStrengthMeter.description: Visual bar with 4 quantum power tiers and dynamic security feedback labels.

GuestBanner.description: High-prominence 'Continue as Guest' trigger with explanation of temporary quantum session.

AuthenticatedHome.description: Step 1 verification landing: displays logged-in user profile or guest badge, session token metadata, secure logout button, and next-step roadmap.

test_attributes.convention: Strict kebab-case role-based data-testid on every interactive control and status element

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts with flat cards. Use glassmorphic layered surfaces with subtle glowing neon borders.
Never use pure black #000000; use deep galactic navy #05070E with ambient cyan/purple flares.
Do NOT use universal transition 'transition: all' because it breaks framer-motion and transforms. Specify 'transition-colors transition-opacity transition-shadow'.
Ensure all text meets WCAG AA contrast against dark backgrounds. Inputs must have clear focus rings.
All form inputs and buttons MUST include the exact data-testid attributes outlined in design_guidelines.json.
Use 'sonner' for toasts; configure it with dark theme and rich colors.
